description: 🚀 Awesome list of open source applications for macOS. https://t.me/s/opensourcemacosapps

summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized awesome-list of free and open source applications for macOS, with each entry giving a one-line description, implementation languages, and sometimes a website or screenshots.
summary.what_it_does: The README is an awesome-style list of roughly 947 open source macOS apps grouped into about 49 categories such as Audio, Backup, Browser, Chat, Cryptocurrency, Database, Development, Git, Editors, Graphics, Productivity and Utilities. Each entry lists the app name, a short description, the programming languages it is written in, and often a project website. The list includes both native macOS apps and cross-platform apps that run on macOS. The README also includes a language legend and summary statistics, and it invites contributions and points readers to a Telegram channel for new apps. The visible portion covers categories from Audio through Web Development; the remaining categories were cut off in the provided text.
use_cases: Finding free open source apps for a Mac
Discovering open source alternatives to paid macOS software
Browsing macOS audio, backup, or database tools by category
Locating native Swift or Objective-C macOS projects to study or contribute to
Choosing a git client, database GUI, or browser for macOS
notable: Covers about 947 listed apps across roughly 49 categories
Each entry shows the implementation languages used
Mixes native macOS apps with cross-platform open source apps
Links to a Telegram channel for new and popular apps
caveats: It is a list of links, not software, so nothing installs or runs from it
Entries are not verified in this summary and may be outdated or unmaintained
The README is truncated, so later categories are not visible here
